correctness.rationale: For each profile \( (h,v) \), the endpoint-coordinate constraints are necessary and sufficient. Direct selection and pairing gives \(N_{m,n}(h,v)=\frac{m!\,n!}{h!\,v!\,2^{h+v}(m-h-2v)!(n-v-2h)!}\). Summing proves the polynomial. The profile constraints give the upper bound on degree, and \(h=\max\{0,2k-m\},\ v=k-h\) constructs a feasible profile for \(k=\min\{m,n,\lfloor(m+n)/3\rfloor\}\). A standard-library brute-force check of all boards with \(1\le m,n\le4\) agrees coefficient-by-coefficient; this is supplemental to the proof.

value.rationale: The induced-matching polynomial is a natural exact invariant of the standard rook-graph family. It gives every size stratum and orientation profile, supplying a reusable baseline for conflict-free pair placement and for testing induced-matching enumeration methods. This is a bounded exact result; no unsupported downstream consequence is claimed.
